title: Yellowed Nutty Vietnamese Tofu Bun Thit Nuong
description: A nutty and light Vietnamese dish featuring shallots and tofu, perfect for a midnight craving, served in a scallop shell vessel

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a small bowl, whisk together nuoc cham sauce and chopped peanuts
In a separate bowl, toss tofu cubes with a pinch of salt and a grind of black pepper
Place a sheet of papillote paper on a flat surface and arrange a small amount of rice vermicelli in the center
Top the vermicelli with a few slices of shallots, a few pieces of tofu, and a sprinkle of pickled carrots
Drizzle the nuoc cham sauce mixture over the top of the filling
Fold the papillote paper over the filling to form a scallop shell shape and press the edges to seal
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients
Place the filled papillote papers on a baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
